passages.text: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of the LORD, “Who will be the first to go up and fight for us against the Canaanites?”
passages.sermon:
Joshua died.
The Israelites lived after Joshua died.
The Israelites wanted to know what to do next.
The Israelites asked the LORD a question.
They said, “Who will go up first for us?”
They wanted someone to fight against the Canaanites first.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַֽיִּשְׁאֲלוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּיהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֧נוּ אֶל־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י בַּתְּחִלָּ֖ה לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “Judah shall go up,” answered the LORD. “Indeed, I have delivered the land into their hands.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the Israelites.
The LORD gave a command.
The LORD said, "Judah will go up."
The LORD said, "I have given the land into Judah's hand."
The LORD promised victory to Judah.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֣ה יַעֲלֶ֑ה הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites. And we likewise will go with you to your territory.” So the Simeonites went with them.
passages.sermon:
Judah spoke to his brother Simeon.
Judah said, “Come with me into my allotted land.
Let us fight against the Canaanites together.
I will also go with you into your allotted land.
Simeon went with Judah.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְשִׁמְע֨וֹן אָחִ֜יו עֲלֵ֧ה אִתִּ֣י בְגוֹרָלִ֗י וְנִֽלָּחֲמָה֙ בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י גַם־ אֲנִ֛י אִתְּךָ֖ בְּגוֹרָלֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אִתּ֖וֹ שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃

passages.text: When Judah attacked, the LORD delivered the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a tribe of Israel.
Judah went up to fight.
The LORD is God.
The LORD gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into the hands of Judah.
Judah fought the Canaanites and the Perizzites at Bezek.
Judah struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ הַכְּנַעֲנִ֥י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֖י בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיַּכּ֣וּם בְּבֶ֔זֶק עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: And there they found Adoni-bezek and fought against him, striking down the Canaanites and Perizzites.
passages.sermon:
The men of Judah and Simeon went to Bezek.
They found Adoni-bezek in Bezek.
They fought against Adoni-bezek.
They struck down the Canaanites.
They struck down the Perizzites.
passages.original: וַֽ֠יִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֥י בֶ֙זֶק֙ בְּבֶ֔זֶק וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ בּ֑וֹ וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַפְּרִזִּֽי׃

passages.text: As Adoni-bezek fled, they pursued him, seized him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
passages.sermon:
Adoni-bezek was a king.
He tried to escape.
The men of Judah chased him.
They caught him.
They cut off his thumbs.
They cut off his big toes.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙נָס֙ אֲדֹ֣נִי בֶ֔זֶק וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרָ֑יו וַיֹּאחֲז֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וַֽיְקַצְּצ֔וּ אֶת־ בְּהֹנ֥וֹת יָדָ֖יו וְרַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered the scraps under my table. As I have done to them, so God has repaid me.” And they brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.
passages.sermon:
Adoni-bezek was a Canaanite king.
He spoke after he was captured.
He said, “Seventy kings sat under my table.
Their thumbs and big toes were cut off.
They gathered scraps from the ground under my table.
I did this to them.
God has repaid me in the same way.”
The men brought Adoni-bezek to Jerusalem.
He died there.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹֽנִי־ בֶ֗זֶק שִׁבְעִ֣ים׀ מְלָכִ֡ים בְּֽהֹנוֹת֩ יְדֵיהֶ֨ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֜ם מְקֻצָּצִ֗ים הָי֤וּ מְלַקְּטִים֙ תַּ֣חַת שֻׁלְחָנִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי כֵּ֥ן שִׁלַּם־ לִ֖י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיְבִיאֻ֥הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃פ

passages.text: Then the men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.
passages.sermon:
The men of Judah fought against Jerusalem.
They captured the city.
They killed the people with the sword.
They set the city on fire.
passages.original: וַיִּלָּחֲמ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיִּלְכְּד֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וַיַּכּ֖וּהָ לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וְאֶת־ הָעִ֖יר שִׁלְּח֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Afterward, the men of Judah marched down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, in the Negev, and in the foothills.
passages.sermon:
The men of Judah were Israelites from the tribe of Judah.
After they fought in Jerusalem, they marched down to new places.
They went to fight against the Canaanites.
The Canaanites lived in three areas.
They lived in the hill country.
They lived in the Negev.
They lived in the foothills.
passages.original: וְאַחַ֗ר יָֽרְדוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָהָ֔ר וְהַנֶּ֖גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָֽה׃

passages.text: Judah also marched against the Canaanites who were living in Hebron (formerly known as Kiriath-arba), and they struck down Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
passages.sermon:
The men of Judah marched against the Canaanites.
The Canaanites were living in Hebron.
Hebron was formerly called Kiriath-arba.
The men of Judah struck down Sheshai.
They struck down Ahiman.
They struck down Talmai.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּחֶבְר֔וֹן וְשֵׁם־ חֶבְר֥וֹן לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֑ע וַיַּכּ֛וּ אֶת־ שֵׁשַׁ֥י וְאֶת־ אֲחִימַ֖ן וְאֶת־ תַּלְמָֽי׃

passages.text: From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
passages.sermon: The men of Judah marched from Hebron.\r\nThey went to attack the people living in Debir.\r\nDebir was once called Kiriath-sepher.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶל־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑יר וְשֵׁם־ דְּבִ֥יר לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת־ סֵֽפֶר׃

passages.text: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
passages.sermon:
Caleb was a leader of the tribe of Judah.
Caleb spoke to the people.
Caleb said, “Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it will receive a reward.”
Caleb promised, “I will give my daughter Acsah to that man as a wife.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־ יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת־ קִרְיַת־ סֵ֖פֶר וּלְכָדָ֑הּ וְנָתַ֥תִּי ל֛וֹ אֶת־ עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: So Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
passages.sermon:
Othniel was the son of Kenaz.
Kenaz was the younger brother of Caleb.
Othniel captured the city of Kiriath-sepher.
Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to Othniel as a wife.
passages.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָהּ֙ עָתְנִיאֵ֣ל בֶּן־ קְנַ֔ז אֲחִ֥י כָלֵ֖ב הַקָּטֹ֣ן מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֛וֹ אֶת־ עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
passages.sermon:
Acsah was Caleb’s daughter.
Othniel was Acsah’s husband.
One day, Acsah came to Othniel.
Acsah urged Othniel to ask her father Caleb for a field.
Acsah got off her donkey.
Caleb saw Acsah.
Caleb asked Acsah, “What do you desire?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֙הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽאֵת־ אָבִ֙יהָ֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וַתִּצְנַ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל הַחֲמ֑וֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ לָ֥הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה־ לָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: “Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.” So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.
passages.sermon:
Acsah was Caleb’s daughter.
Caleb had given Acsah land in the Negev.
Acsah spoke to Caleb.
Acsah said, “Give me a blessing.”
Acsah said, “You have given me land in the Negev.”
Acsah said, “Give me springs of water also.”
Caleb gave Acsah the upper springs.
Caleb gave Acsah the lower springs.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ הָֽבָה־ לִּ֣י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔נִי וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַיִּתֶּן־ לָ֣הּ כָּלֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּ֔ית וְאֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּֽית׃פ

passages.text: Now the descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up with the men of Judah from the City of Palms to the Wilderness of Judah in the Negev near Arad. They went to live among the people.
passages.sermon:
The Kenites were descendants of Moses’ father-in-law.
They left the City of Palms.
They traveled with the men of Judah.
They went to the Wilderness of Judah.
This wilderness was in the Negev, near Arad.
The Kenites went there.
They settled among the people.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י קֵינִי֩ חֹתֵ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה עָל֨וּ מֵעִ֤יר הַתְּמָרִים֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִדְבַּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּנֶ֣גֶב עֲרָ֑ד וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃

passages.text: Then the men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites, attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and devoted the city to destruction. So it was called Hormah.
passages.sermon:
The men of Judah joined with their brothers from the tribe of Simeon.
They went together to the city of Zephath.
Canaanites lived in Zephath.
Judah and Simeon attacked the Canaanites in Zephath.
They defeated the Canaanites.
They destroyed the city completely.
They devoted the city to destruction.
They named the city Hormah.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־ שִׁמְע֣וֹן אָחִ֔יו וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב צְפַ֑ת וַיַּחֲרִ֣ימוּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שֵׁם־ הָעִ֖יר חָרְמָֽה׃

passages.text: And Judah also captured Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron—each with its territory.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a tribe of Israel.
Judah captured Gaza.
Judah captured the territory around Gaza.
Judah captured Ashkelon.
Judah captured the territory around Ashkelon.
Judah captured Ekron.
Judah captured the territory around Ekron.
passages.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־ עַזָּ֣ה וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלָ֔הּ וְאֶֽת־ אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלָ֑הּ וְאֶת־ עֶקְר֖וֹן וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The LORD was with Judah, and they took possession of the hill country; but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the plains because they had chariots of iron.
passages.sermon:
The LORD was with Judah.
Judah took possession of the hill country.
Judah could not drive out the people living in the plains.
The people in the plains had chariots made of iron.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶתּ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖רֶשׁ אֶת־ הָהָ֑ר כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְהוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָעֵ֔מֶק כִּי־ רֶ֥כֶב בַּרְזֶ֖ל לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Just as Moses had promised, Judah gave Hebron to Caleb, who drove out the descendants of the three sons of Anak.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses promised Caleb that he would receive Hebron.
Judah gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had promised.
Caleb received Hebron.
Caleb drove out the descendants of the three sons of Anak from Hebron.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ לְכָלֵב֙ אֶת־ חֶבְר֔וֹן כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶת־ שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י הָעֲנָֽק׃

passages.text: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the Benjamites.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin tried to take Jerusalem.
The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem.
The Benjamites did not drive out the Jebusites.
The Jebusites stayed in Jerusalem.
The Jebusites still live there with the Benjamites to this day.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹ֥א הוֹרִ֖ישׁוּ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַיְבוּסִ֜י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: The house of Joseph also attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
passages.sermon: The house of Joseph was a tribe of Israel.\r\nThe house of Joseph went up to attack Bethel.\r\nThe LORD was with the house of Joseph.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֧וּ בֵית־ יוֹסֵ֛ף גַּם־ הֵ֖ם בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וַֽיהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽם׃

passages.text: They sent spies to Bethel (formerly known as Luz), and when the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, “Please show us how to get into the city, and we will treat you kindly.”
passages.sermon:
The house of Joseph sent spies to Bethel.
Bethel was formerly called Luz.
The spies saw a man coming out of the city.
The spies spoke to the man.
They said, "Please show us the entrance to the city."
They said, "We will treat you kindly."
passages.original: וַיָּתִ֥ירוּ בֵית־ יוֹסֵ֖ף בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְשֵׁם־ הָעִ֥יר לְפָנִ֖ים לֽוּז׃ וַיִּרְאוּ֙ הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ יוֹצֵ֣א מִן־ הָעִ֑יר וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֗וֹ הַרְאֵ֤נוּ נָא֙ אֶת־ מְב֣וֹא הָעִ֔יר וְעָשִׂ֥ינוּ עִמְּךָ֖ חָֽסֶד׃

passages.text: So the man showed them the entrance to the city, and they put the city to the sword but released that man and all his family.
passages.sermon:
The house of Joseph attacked Bethel.
The LORD was with the house of Joseph.
A man came out of the city.
The spies from Joseph saw the man.
They asked the man to show them the entrance to the city.
The man showed them the entrance to the city.
The house of Joseph entered the city.
They struck the city with the sword.
They killed the people in the city.
They did not kill the man who helped them.
They did not kill his family.
They let the man and his family go free.
passages.original: וַיַּרְאֵם֙ אֶת־ מְב֣וֹא הָעִ֔יר וַיַּכּ֥וּ אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וְאֶת־ הָאִ֥ישׁ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ שִׁלֵּֽחוּ׃

passages.text: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
passages.sermon:
A man left his city.
He went to the land of the Hittites.
He built a new city there.
He named the city Luz.
The city is still called Luz today.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ הָאִ֔ישׁ אֶ֖רֶץ הַחִתִּ֑ים וַיִּ֣בֶן עִ֗יר וַיִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ ל֔וּז ה֣וּא שְׁמָ֔הּ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ

passages.text: At that time Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and their villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
passages.sermon:
Manasseh was a tribe of Israel.
Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth-shean.
Manasseh did not drive out the villages around Beth-shean.
Manasseh did not drive out the people of Taanach.
Manasseh did not drive out the villages around Taanach.
Manasseh did not drive out the people living in Dor.
Manasseh did not drive out the villages around Dor.
Manasseh did not drive out the people living in Ibleam.
Manasseh did not drive out the villages around Ibleam.
Manasseh did not drive out the people living in Megiddo.
Manasseh did not drive out the villages around Megiddo.
The Canaanites wanted to stay in this land.
The Canaanites remained in the land.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת־ בֵּית־ שְׁאָ֣ן וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֶיהָ֮ וְאֶת־ תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֶיהָ֒ וְאֶת־ יֹשֵׁב ד֜וֹר וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֶ֗יהָ וְאֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֤י יִבְלְעָם֙ וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י מְגִדּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ בְּנוֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיּ֙וֹאֶל֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: When Israel became stronger, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor, but they never drove them out completely.
passages.sermon: Israel became strong.\r\nIsrael forced the Canaanites to work for them.\r\nIsrael did not drive out the Canaanites completely.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־ חָזַ֣ק יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י לָמַ֑ס וְהוֹרֵ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א הוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Ephraim also failed to drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer; so the Canaanites continued to dwell among them in Gezer.
passages.sermon:
Ephraim was a tribe of Israel.
Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer.
The Canaanites stayed in Gezer.
The Canaanites lived among the people of Ephraim in Gezer.
passages.original: וְאֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹ֣א הוֹרִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּגָ֑זֶר וַיֵּ֧שֶׁב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י בְּקִרְבּ֖וֹ בְּגָֽזֶר׃פ

passages.text: Zebulun failed to drive out the inhabitants of Kitron and Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and served as forced laborers.
passages.sermon:
Zebulun was a tribe of Israel.
Zebulun did not drive out the people living in Kitron.
Zebulun did not drive out the people living in Nahalol.
The Canaanites continued to live among Zebulun.
The Canaanites became forced laborers for Zebulun.
passages.original: זְבוּלֻ֗ן לֹ֤א הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י קִטְר֔וֹן וְאֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י נַהֲלֹ֑ל וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ לָמַֽס׃ס

passages.text: Asher failed to drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.
passages.sermon:
Asher was a tribe of Israel.
Asher did not drive out the people living in Acco.
Asher did not drive out the people living in Sidon.
Asher did not drive out the people living in Ahlab.
Asher did not drive out the people living in Achzib.
Asher did not drive out the people living in Helbah.
Asher did not drive out the people living in Aphik.
Asher did not drive out the people living in Rehob.
passages.original: אָשֵׁ֗ר לֹ֤א הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י עַכּ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י צִיד֑וֹן וְאֶת־ אַחְלָ֤ב וְאֶת־ אַכְזִיב֙ וְאֶת־ חֶלְבָּ֔ה וְאֶת־ אֲפִ֖יק וְאֶת־ רְחֹֽב׃

passages.text: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, because they did not drive them out.
passages.sermon: The tribe of Asher did not drive out the Canaanites from the land.\r\nThe Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants.\r\nThe Canaanites continued to live in the land with the Asherites.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ הָאָ֣שֵׁרִ֔י בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֖י לֹ֥א הוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Naphtali failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath. So the Naphtalites also lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, but the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath served them as forced laborers.
passages.sermon:
Naphtali was a tribe of Israel.
Naphtali did not drive out the people living in Beth-shemesh.
Naphtali did not drive out the people living in Beth-anath.
The people of Naphtali lived among the Canaanites.
The Canaanites were the original inhabitants of the land.
The people of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath became forced laborers for Naphtali.
passages.original: נַפְתָּלִ֗י לֹֽא־ הוֹרִ֞ישׁ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י בֵֽית־ שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וְאֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵית־ עֲנָ֔ת וַיֵּ֕שֶׁב בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֤י בֵֽית־ שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וּבֵ֣ית עֲנָ֔ת הָי֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לָמַֽס׃ס

passages.text: The Amorites forced the Danites into the hill country and did not allow them to come down into the plain.
passages.sermon: The Amorites were a strong people living in the land.\r\nThe Amorites forced the tribe of Dan to stay in the hill country.\r\nThe Amorites did not allow the Danites to come down into the plain.
passages.original: וַיִּלְחֲצ֧וּ הָאֱמֹרִ֛י אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ דָ֖ן הָהָ֑רָה כִּי־ לֹ֥א נְתָנ֖וֹ לָרֶ֥דֶת לָעֵֽמֶק׃

passages.text: And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.
passages.sermon:
The Amorites were a people living in Canaan.
The Amorites decided to live in Mount Heres.
The Amorites also decided to live in Aijalon.
The Amorites also decided to live in Shaalbim.
The house of Joseph was a tribe of Israel.
The house of Joseph became stronger.
The house of Joseph forced the Amorites to work for them.
The Amorites became forced laborers for the house of Joseph.
passages.original: וַיּ֤וֹאֶל הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בְּהַר־ חֶ֔רֶס בְּאַיָּל֖וֹן וּבְשַֽׁעַלְבִ֑ים וַתִּכְבַּד֙ יַ֣ד בֵּית־ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָמַֽס׃

passages.text: And the border of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of Akrabbim to Sela and beyond.
passages.sermon:
The Amorites were a people living in the land.
Their border started at the Ascent of Akrabbim.
Their border reached to Sela.
Their border went even farther beyond Sela.
passages.original: וּגְבוּל֙ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י מִֽמַּעֲלֵ֖ה עַקְרַבִּ֑ים מֵהַסֶּ֖לַע וָמָֽעְלָה׃פ
